mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO quant_live_dispatch_guard (credential_id, symbol, active_dispatch_key, updated_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{symbol}, NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
INSERT IGNORE INTO quant_live_account_settings_intent (credential_id, symbol, margin_mode, leverage, created_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{symbol}, #{marginMode}, #{leverage}, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_live_dispatch_guard SET active_dispatch_key=#{key}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND active_dispatch_key IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_order_dispatch_ticket (credential_id, symbol, idempotency_key, operation_type, client_order_id, strategy_instance_id, lease_epoch, dispatch_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{symbol}, #{key}, #{operation}, #{clientOrderId}, #{instanceId}, #{epoch}, 'DISPATCHING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_order_dispatch_ticket SET dispatch_status='ACKED', exchange_order_id=#{orderId}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND dispatch_status='DISPATCHING'

UPDATE quant_order_dispatch_ticket SET dispatch_status='CONFIG_APPLIED', updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND operation_type='CONFIG_SETTINGS' AND dispatch_status='DISPATCHING' AND exchange_order_id IS NULL
UPDATE quant_order_dispatch_ticket SET dispatch_status='FAILED_NOT_SENT', updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND dispatch_status='DISPATCHING'
UPDATE quant_order_dispatch_ticket SET dispatch_status='UNKNOWN', updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND dispatch_status='DISPATCHING'
mapper.select: SELECT g.active_dispatch_key FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key AND t.symbol=g.symbol WHERE g.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND g.symbol=#{symbol} AND t.client_order_id=#{clientOrderId} AND t.operation_type=#{operation} AND t.dispatch_status IN ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN')

SELECT g.credential_id AS credentialId, g.symbol AS symbol, g.active_dispatch_key AS dispatchKey, t.operation_type AS operationType, t.client_order_id AS clientOrderId, t.dispatch_status AS dispatchStatus, t.exchange_order_id AS exchangeOrderId FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g LEFT JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key AND t.symbol=g.symbol WHERE g.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND g.symbol=#{symbol} AND g.active_dispatch_key IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT g.credential_id AS credentialId, g.symbol AS symbol, g.active_dispatch_key AS dispatchKey, t.operation_type AS operationType, t.client_order_id AS clientOrderId, t.dispatch_status AS dispatchStatus, t.exchange_order_id AS exchangeOrderId FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key AND t.symbol=g.symbol WHERE g.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND (#{symbol} IS NULL OR g.symbol=#{symbol}) AND t.operation_type='PROTECT_CANCEL' AND t.dispatch_status IN ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN') ORDER BY g.updated_at ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT g.credential_id AS credentialId, g.symbol AS symbol, g.active_dispatch_key AS dispatchKey, t.operation_type AS operationType, t.client_order_id AS clientOrderId, t.dispatch_status AS dispatchStatus, t.exchange_order_id AS exchangeOrderId FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key AND t.symbol=g.symbol WHERE g.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND (#{symbol} IS NULL OR g.symbol=#{symbol}) AND t.operation_type IN ('PROTECT_CREATE','PROTECT_CANCEL') AND t.dispatch_status IN ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN') ORDER BY g.updated_at ASC LIMIT 100
SELECT dispatch_status FROM quant_order_dispatch_ticket WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT g.credential_id AS credential_id, g.symbol AS symbol, g.active_dispatch_key AS dispatch_key, g.updated_at AS blocked_at, t.operation_type AS operation_type, t.client_order_id AS client_order_id, t.dispatch_status AS dispatch_status, t.exchange_order_id AS exchange_order_id, t.strategy_instance_id AS strategy_instance_id, t.lease_epoch AS lease_epoch FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g LEFT JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key WHERE g.active_dispatch_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.updated_at ASC LIMIT 100
